request.hypothesis: All user journeys (browse, cart, checkout) will experience high error rates and latency due to the frontend being unavailable. The system should recover quickly within 30 seconds as the frontend is stateless and Kubernetes can recreate pods.
request.reason: Frontend is the critical entrypoint for all user journeys. It has not been tested with any failure type, and pod-kill is a more realistic failure scenario than service-down for production environments.
